title: PR-1842: bound checkout payment-client sockets
body: Merged into checkout-api release/v4.7. Configuration diff: payment_client.pool.max_connections 48 -> 8 per worker; acquire_timeout_ms remains 250; worker count remains 4. Goal: reduce idle sockets during quiet periods. Unit checks passed; release note requests on-call observation because no busy-period capacity exercise accompanied this change. No provider-adapter or fraud-service configuration changed.
